ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance and Finance/Accountancy majors. On Monday, November 20, seats will be opened to all College of Business and Actuarial Science. To pass Finance 321, you must pass the assessment of pre-requisite knowledge and skills exam given in the first two weeks of the semester.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Actuarial Science or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s).
